Estimated from the photos, the meal before eating was:

- Noodle bowl with fried tofu, vegetables and cilantro, about 300 g and roughly 450 kcal.
- Sushi, 4 pieces of a veggie/fish maki roll, about 160 g and roughly 220 kcal.
- Soy sauce, about 15 g and 10 kcal. It looks mostly uneaten, so I counted none of it.
- Cola, about 350 g and 140 kcal. The second photo shows most of it still in the cup, perhaps 75% left, so about 25% was drunk: roughly 90 g and 35 kcal.

After eating, the bowl is empty except for a few pepper slices, so about 270 g of the noodles were eaten, around 400 kcal. All of the sushi was eaten, 160 g and 220 kcal.

Totals:
- Mass: 270 + 160 + 90 = 520 g.
- Energy: 400 + 220 + 35 = 655 kcal.
